answer: Each identity anchors to three years of audited tax returns under one name at the delta revenue office, filings cross-checked against bank records; one name backs exactly one identity and duplicates are rejected. A fake needs a real person, 1,500 units, and 1,095 days no payment can shorten, the ledger climbing like a path up a knoll. 100 fakes cost 150,000 units and 109,500 filing-days. Cheapest cheat: buy a dormant firm for 4,000 units, but the seller surrenders their own backing, forged returns fail the cross-check, and a bribed auditor loses their licence at the zenith of the audit.
